name: Continuum
framework: Buildless HTML, CSS, ES modules with Node HTTP server
decisions: Continuum is the sole public brand; keep legacy receipt/calendar identifiers compatible.
Personal accounts and SQLite persistence are the default; demo access is opt-in and never enabled in production.
Account settings show actual integration setup, connection and delivery state.
Use corrected text contrast, adequate pointer targets, explicit labels and keyboard focus. Keep technical response evidence behind disclosures.
Preserve restrained blue/charcoal surfaces and existing vanilla primitives; no invented endorsements.
inspiration: 21st catalog metadata: App Dashboard Layout (28770), Notification Panel (27135); implemented using existing vanilla components without paid code retrieval.
